description: This file defines the HttpRequestValue class, a custom FluidValue implementation for accessing HTTP request properties within Liquid templates in OrchardCore.

classes.name: HttpRequestValue
classes.description: A FluidValue implementation that exposes HTTP request properties for Liquid templates.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Checks if another FluidValue is an instance of HttpRequestValue.

methods.name: ToBooleanValue
methods.description: Returns true, indicating the request is considered truthy.

methods.name: ToObjectValue
methods.description: Returns null as the object representation.

methods.name: WriteToAsync
methods.description: Writes the string representation asynchronously to a TextWriter.

methods.name: GetValueAsync
methods.description: Retrieves specific HTTP request properties based on the provided name.

methods.name: GetHttpRequest
methods.description: Helper method to obtain the HttpRequest object from the template context.
